name: app.R
content:
# app.R — Antarctic Sunscreen Ecotoxicology Predictor
# Shinylive-compatible (no server dependencies)

library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(scales)

source("R/helpers.R")
source("R/i18n.R")

# --- Load precomputed data ---
params_df <- read_csv("data/model_parameters.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
ec50_df <- read_csv("data/ec50_summary.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
fig3_data <- read_csv("data/fig3_photophysiology.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
fig4_data <- read_csv("data/fig4_cytometry.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Time colors (colorblind-friendly)
time_colors <- c("24h" = "#E69F00", "48h" = "#56B4E9", "72h" = "#009E73")

# Variable choices per experiment
var_choices <- list(
  Exp1 = c("Q_Yield", "Chl_Act_pct"),
  Exp2 = c("Q_Yield", "Chl_Act_pct", "P4")
)

# --- UI ---
ui <- page_navbar(
  id = "navbar",
  title = textOutput("app_title_text", inline = TRUE),
  window_title = "Antarctic Sunscreen Ecotoxicology Predictor",
  theme = bs_theme(
    version = 5,
    bootswatch = "flatly",
    primary = "#2C7BB6",
    "navbar-bg" = "#1a3a5c",
    base_font = font_collection("Source Sans Pro", "Helvetica Neue", "Helvetica", "Arial", "sans-serif")
  ),
  fillable = FALSE,
  header = tagList(
    tags$style(HTML("
      /* Navbar tabs always visible */
      .navbar-nav .nav-link {
        color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75) !important;
        opacity: 1 !important;
        visibility: visible !important;
      }
      .navbar-nav .nav-link:hover {
        color: #ffffff !important;
      }
      .navbar-nav .nav-link.active {
        color: #ffffff !important;
        font-weight: 700 !important;
      }
    ")),
    # Client-side download helpers for Shinylive (no server)
    tags$script(HTML("
      Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler('download_csv', function(msg) {
        var blob = new Blob([msg.content], {type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;'});
        var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        var a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = url; a.download = msg.filename;
        document.body.appendChild(a); a.click();
        document.body.removeChild(a); URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      });
      Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler('download_png', function(msg) {
        var byteChars = atob(msg.content);
        var byteNumbers = new Array(byteChars.length);
        for (var i = 0; i < byteChars.length; i++) {
          byteNumbers[i] = byteChars.charCodeAt(i);
        }
        var byteArray = new Uint8Array(byteNumbers);
        var blob = new Blob([byteArray], {type: 'image/png'});
        var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        var a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = url; a.download = msg.filename;
        document.body.appendChild(a); a.click();
        document.body.removeChild(a); URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      });
    "))
  ),

  # Language toggle in navbar
  nav_spacer(),
  nav_item(
    actionButton("lang_toggle", "ES",
                 class = "btn btn-outline-light btn-sm",
                 style = "margin-top: 4px;")
  ),
  nav_item(input_dark_mode(id = "dark_mode")),

  # --- Tab 1: Prediction Tool ---
  nav_panel(
    title = uiOutput("tab_predict_title", inline = TRUE),
    value = "predict",
    layout_sidebar(
      sidebar = sidebar(
        width = 350,
        radioButtons("experiment", label = NULL,
                     choices = c("Exp1", "Exp2"), selected = "Exp1",
                     inline = TRUE),
        uiOutput("ui_variable"),
        checkboxGroupInput("time_points", label = NULL,
                          choices = c("24h" = 24, "48h" = 48, "72h" = 72),
                          selected = c(24, 48, 72), inline = TRUE),
        hr(),
        radioButtons("input_method", label = NULL,
                     choices = c("manual", "file"), selected = "manual",
                     inline = TRUE),
        conditionalPanel(
          condition = "input.input_method == 'manual'",
          textAreaInput("conc_text", label = NULL,
                       value = "5, 10, 20, 50",
                       placeholder = "e.g., 5, 10, 20, 50",
                       rows = 3)
        ),
        conditionalPanel(
          condition = "input.input_method == 'file'",
          fileInput("conc_file", label = NULL,
                   accept = c(".csv", ".txt", ".tsv")),
          uiOutput("ui_file_col")
        ),
        actionButton("btn_predict", label = "Generate Predictions",
                    class = "btn-primary w-100 mt-2",
                    icon = icon("calculator")),
        hr(),
        uiOutput("ui_sidebar_ref")
      ),

      # Main panel
      uiOutput("ui_value_boxes"),

      # Plot card
      card(
        card_header(
          class = "d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center",
          uiOutput("card_plot_title", inline = TRUE),
          actionButton("download_png", label = NULL,
                      class = "btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm",
                      icon = icon("download"))
        ),
        plotOutput("dr_plot", height = "500px"),
        card_footer(
          class = "text-muted small",
          uiOutput("plot_footer_text")
        )
      ),

      # Table card
      card(
        card_header(
          class = "d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center",
          uiOutput("card_table_title", inline = TRUE),
          actionButton("download_csv", label = NULL,
                      class = "btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm",
                      icon = icon("download"))
        ),
        DTOutput("pred_table")
      ),

      # Warning panel
      uiOutput("ui_warnings")
    )
  ),

  # --- Tab 2: EC50 Reference ---
  nav_panel(
    title = uiOutput("tab_ec50_title", inline = TRUE),
    value = "ec50",
    layout_columns(
      col_widths = c(6, 6),
      card(
        card_header(uiOutput("ec50_table_title", inline = TRUE)),
        DTOutput("ec50_table")
      ),
      card(
        card_header(uiOutput("ec50_forest_title", inline = TRUE)),
        plotOutput("ec50_forest", height = "450px")
      )
    ),
    card(
      card_header(uiOutput("ec50_interp_title", inline = TRUE)),
      uiOutput("ec50_interp_body")
    )
  ),

  # --- Tab 3: Study Data ---
  nav_panel(
    title = uiOutput("tab_data_title", inline = TRUE),
    value = "data",
    navset_card_tab(
      nav_panel(
        title = uiOutput("data_photo_tab_title", inline = TRUE),
        value = "photo",
        card_header(uiOutput("data_photo_header", inline = TRUE)),
        plotOutput("data_photo_plot", height = "400px"),
        DTOutput("data_photo_table")
      ),
      nav_panel(
        title = uiOutput("data_cyto_tab_title", inline = TRUE),
        value = "cyto",
        card_header(uiOutput("data_cyto_header", inline = TRUE)),
        plotOutput("data_cyto_plot", height = "400px"),
        DTOutput("data_cyto_table")
      )
    )
  ),

  # --- Tab 4: Methods & About ---
  nav_panel(
    title = uiOutput("tab_methods_title", inline = TRUE),
    value = "methods",
    layout_columns(
      col_widths = c(6, 6),
      card(
        card_header(uiOutput("methods_study_header", inline = TRUE)),
        card_body(uiOutput("methods_study_body"))
      ),
      card(
        card_header(uiOutput("methods_stats_header", inline = TRUE)),
        card_body(
          withMathJax(uiOutput("methods_stats_body"))
        )
      )
    ),
    card(
      card_header(uiOutput("methods_citation_header", inline = TRUE)),
      card_body(uiOutput("methods_citation_body"))
    )
  )
)

# --- Server ---
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # --- Reactive: language ---
  lang <- reactiveVal("en")

  observeEvent(input$lang_toggle, {
    current <- lang()
    new_lang <- if (current == "en") "es" else "en"
    lang(new_lang)
    updateActionButton(session, "lang_toggle",
                      label = t_("lang_toggle", new_lang))
  })

  # --- UI text outputs (reactive to language) ---
  output$app_title_text <- renderText(t_("app_title", lang()))
  output$tab_predict_title <- renderUI(t_("tab_predict", lang()))
  output$tab_ec50_title <- renderUI(t_("tab_ec50", lang()))
  output$tab_data_title <- renderUI(t_("tab_data", lang()))
  output$tab_methods_title <- renderUI(t_("tab_methods", lang()))

  # Sidebar labels
  observe({
    l <- lang()
    updateRadioButtons(session, "experiment", label = t_("experiment", l))
    updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "time_points", label = t_("time_points", l))
    updateRadioButtons(session, "input_method", label = t_("input_method", l),
                      choiceNames = c(t_("input_manual", l), t_("input_file", l)),
                      choiceValues = c("manual", "file"))
    updateTextAreaInput(session, "conc_text", label = t_("conc_label", l),
                       placeholder = t_("conc_placeholder", l))
    updateActionButton(session, "btn_predict", label = t_("btn_predict", l))
  })

  # Variable selector (dynamic based on experiment)
  output$ui_variable <- renderUI({
    l <- lang()
    exp <- input$experiment
    choices <- var_choices[[exp]]
    labels <- sapply(choices, function(v) t_(paste0("var_", v), l))
    names(choices) <- labels
    selectInput("variable", label = t_("variable", l), choices = choices)
  })

  # File column selector
  output$ui_file_col <- renderUI({
    req(input$conc_file)
    l <- lang()
    tryCatch({
      df <- read_csv(input$conc_file$datapath, show_col_types = FALSE, n_max = 5)
      cols <- names(df)
      selectInput("file_col", label = t_("file_col_label", l), choices = cols)
    }, error = function(e) {
      p(class = "text-danger", t_("warn_file_error", l))
    })
  })

  # Sidebar reference
  output$ui_sidebar_ref <- renderUI({
    l <- lang()
    tagList(
      tags$details(
        tags$summary(tags$small(t_("zone_legend_title", l))),
        tags$ul(class = "small",
          tags$li(style = "color: #198754;", t_("zone_interpolation", l)),
          tags$li(style = "color: #856404;", t_("zone_near_extrap", l)),
          tags$li(style = "color: #842029;", t_("zone_far_extrap", l))
        ),
        tags$small(class = "text-muted", t_("tested_range", l))
      )
    )
  })

  # --- Reactive: concentrations ---
  user_concs <- reactive({
    if (input$input_method == "manual") {
      parse_concentrations(input$conc_text)
    } else {
      req(input$conc_file, input$file_col)
      tryCatch({
        df <- read_csv(input$conc_file$datapath, show_col_types = FALSE)
        vals <- df[[input$file_col]]
        nums <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(vals))
        sort(unique(nums[!is.na(nums) & nums >= 0]))
      }, error = function(e) numeric(0))
    }
  })

  # --- Reactive: model ID ---
  model_id <- reactive({
    req(input$experiment, input$variable)
    if (input$variable == "P4") {
      "Exp2_P4"
    } else {
      paste(input$experiment, input$variable, sep = "_")
    }
  })

  # --- Reactive: predictions ---
  # Track whether the user has clicked Generate at least once
  has_predicted <- reactiveVal(FALSE)
  observeEvent(input$btn_predict, { has_predicted(TRUE) })

  # Auto-retrigger: increment a counter to invalidate pred_results
  auto_trigger <- reactiveVal(0)
  observe({
    # Touch these inputs so this observer fires on change
    input$experiment; input$variable; input$time_points; input$conc_text
    input$conc_file; input$file_col
    if (has_predicted()) {
      auto_trigger(isolate(auto_trigger()) + 1)
    }
  })

  pred_results <- eventReactive(list(input$btn_predict, auto_trigger()), {
    concs <- user_concs()
    if (length(concs) == 0) return(NULL)

    mid <- model_id()
    times <- as.integer(input$time_points)
    l <- lang()

    rows <- list()
    idx <- 0
    for (th in times) {
      p <- get_params(params_df, mid, th)
      if (length(p$b) == 0) next

      for (conc in concs) {
        idx <- idx + 1
        pred <- predict_with_intervals(conc, p)
        quality <- assess_quality(conc, pred$pred, p$d, p$c_min,
                                  input$variable, l)
        rows[[idx]] <- data.frame(
          concentration_mg_L = conc,
          time_h = th,
          predicted = round(pred$pred, 4),
          ci_lo = round(pred$ci_lo, 4),
          ci_hi = round(pred$ci_hi, 4),
          pi_lo = round(pred$pi_lo, 4),
          pi_hi = round(pred$pi_hi, 4),
          pct_change = quality$pct_change,
          severity = quality$severity,
          zone = quality$zone,
          zone_color = quality$color,
          quality_text = quality$quality,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
    }

    if (length(rows) == 0) return(NULL)
    do.call(rbind, rows)
  })

  # --- Value boxes ---
  output$ui_value_boxes <- renderUI({
    l <- lang()
    results <- pred_results()
    mid <- model_id()
    times <- as.integer(input$time_points)

    # EC50: use first selected time
    ec50_row <- ec50_df[ec50_df$model_id == mid & ec50_df$time_h == times[1], ]
    ec50_val <- if (nrow(ec50_row) > 0) round(ec50_row$ec50[1], 1) else "N/A"

    # Control response: d parameter for first time
    p <- get_params(params_df, mid, times[1])
    ctrl_val <- if (length(p$d) > 0) round(p$d, 3) else "N/A"

    # N concentrations
    n_conc <- if (!is.null(results)) length(unique(results$concentration_mg_L)) else 0

    layout_columns(
      col_widths = c(4, 4, 4),
      value_box(
        title = t_("vb_ec50", l),
        value = ec50_val,
        showcase = icon("crosshairs"),
        theme = "primary"
      ),
      value_box(
        title = t_("vb_control", l),
        value = ctrl_val,
        showcase = icon("flask"),
        theme = "success"
      ),
      value_box(
        title = t_("vb_n_conc", l),
        value = n_conc,
        showcase = icon("list-ol"),
        theme = "info"
      )
    )
  })

  # --- Plot ---
  make_plot <- reactive({
    results <- pred_results()
    req(results)

    mid <- model_id()
    times <- as.integer(input$time_points)
    l <- lang()
    var <- input$variable
    exp <- input$experiment

    # Determine concentration range for curves
    max_user <- max(results$concentration_mg_L, na.rm = TRUE)
    curve_max <- max(max_user * 1.1, 80)

    # Generate smooth curves for each time
    curve_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(times, function(th) {
      generate_curve_data(params_df, mid, th, c(0.1, curve_max))
    }))

    if (is.null(curve_data) || nrow(curve_data) == 0) return(NULL)

    # Observation data
    if (var == "P4") {
      obs <- fig4_data |>
        filter(population == "P4", time_h %in% times) |>
        mutate(
          mean_val = mean_pct / 100,
          se = sd_pct / (100 * sqrt(n)),
          time_label = paste0(time_h, "h")
        )
    } else {
      obs <- fig3_data |>
        filter(experiment == exp, variable == var, time_h %in% times) |>
        mutate(
          mean_val = mean,
          time_label = paste0(time_h, "h")
        )
    }

    # User predictions
    user_pts <- results |>
      mutate(time_label = paste0(time_h, "h"))

    # Build plot
    p <- ggplot() +
      # Extrapolation zone shading (if user goes beyond 75)
      {if (max_user > 75) annotate(
        "rect", xmin = 75, xmax = curve_max, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
        fill = "#E69F00", alpha = 0.05
      )} +
      # PI band (light)
      geom_ribbon(data = curve_data,
                  aes(x = concentration_mg_L,
                      ymin = pi_lo, ymax = pi_hi,
                      fill = time_label),
                  alpha = 0.08) +
      # CI band (darker)
      geom_ribbon(data = curve_data,
                  aes(x = concentration_mg_L,
                      ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi,
                      fill = time_label),
                  alpha = 0.20) +
      # Fitted curve
      geom_line(data = curve_data,
                aes(x = concentration_mg_L, y = pred,
                    color = time_label),
                linewidth = 0.9)

    # Observation points with error bars
    if (nrow(obs) > 0) {
      if (var == "P4") {
        p <- p +
          geom_errorbar(data = obs,
                       aes(x = concentration_mg_L,
                           ymin = mean_val - se, ymax = mean_val + se,
                           color = time_label),
                       width = 2, linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.6) +
          geom_point(data = obs,
                    aes(x = concentration_mg_L, y = mean_val,
                        color = time_label),
                    size = 2, alpha = 0.7)
      } else {
        p <- p +
          geom_errorbar(data = obs,
                       aes(x = concentration_mg_L,
                           ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se,
                           color = time_label),
                       width = 2, linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.6) +
          geom_point(data = obs,
                    aes(x = concentration_mg_L, y = mean,
                        color = time_label),
                    size = 2, alpha = 0.7)
      }
    }

    # User predicted points (diamonds)
    p <- p +
      geom_point(data = user_pts,
                aes(x = concentration_mg_L, y = predicted,
                    color = time_label),
                shape = 18, size = 5) +
      # Tested range boundary
      geom_vline(xintercept = 75, linetype = "dashed",
                color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.5) +
      scale_color_manual(values = time_colors, name = NULL) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = time_colors, name = NULL) +
      labs(
        x = t_("plot_xlab", l),
        y = t_("plot_ylab", l)
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")

    # Clip negative predictions in plot
    y_range <- range(c(curve_data$pi_lo, curve_data$pi_hi,
                       user_pts$predicted), na.rm = TRUE)
    if (y_range[1] < 0) {
      p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_range[2] * 1.05))
    }

    p
  })

  output$dr_plot <- renderPlot({
    make_plot()
  }, res = 96)

  # Plot card titles
  output$card_plot_title <- renderUI(tags$span(t_("card_plot", lang())))
  output$card_table_title <- renderUI(tags$span(t_("card_table", lang())))

  # Plot footer
  output$plot_footer_text <- renderUI({
    l <- lang()
    tags$span(
      t_("plot_subtitle_ci", l), " | ", t_("plot_subtitle_pi", l)
    )
  })

  # --- Prediction table ---
  output$pred_table <- renderDT({
    results <- pred_results()
    req(results)

    l <- lang()
    display <- results |>
      mutate(
        ci = paste0("[", ci_lo, ", ", ci_hi, "]"),
        pi = paste0("[", pi_lo, ", ", pi_hi, "]"),
        pct_display = ifelse(is.na(pct_change), "\u2014",
                            paste0(ifelse(pct_change >= 0, "+", ""),
                                   pct_change, "%"))
      ) |>
      select(
        !!t_("col_conc", l) := concentration_mg_L,
        !!t_("col_time", l) := time_h,
        !!t_("col_predicted", l) := predicted,
        !!t_("col_ci", l) := ci,
        !!t_("col_pi", l) := pi,
        !!t_("col_pct_change", l) := pct_display,
        !!t_("col_severity", l) := severity,
        !!t_("col_zone", l) := quality_text
      )

    # Zone colors for row styling
    zone_colors <- results$zone_color

    datatable(
      display,
      options = list(
        pageLength = 25,
        dom = "tip",
        scrollX = TRUE
      ),
      rownames = FALSE,
      class = "compact stripe"
    ) |>
      formatStyle(
        t_("col_zone", l),
        backgroundColor = styleEqual(
          unique(results$quality_text),
          sapply(unique(results$quality_text), function(qt) {
            results$zone_color[results$quality_text == qt][1]
          })
        ),
        color = "black"
      )
  })

  # --- Warnings ---
  output$ui_warnings <- renderUI({
    results <- pred_results()
    if (is.null(results)) return(NULL)

    l <- lang()
    mid <- model_id()
    times <- as.integer(input$time_points)
    warnings <- list()

    for (th in times) {
      p <- get_params(params_df, mid, th)
      if (length(p$b) > 0 && is_poorly_identified(p)) {
        warnings <- c(warnings, list(
          div(class = "alert alert-warning mt-2",
              icon("exclamation-triangle"),
              paste0(th, "h: ", t_("warn_poorly_id", l)))
        ))
      }
    }

    if (any(results$zone == "far_extrapolation")) {
      msg <- if (l == "en") {
        "Some concentrations are in the far extrapolation zone (>150 mg/L). These predictions are NOT recommended for decision-making."
      } else {
        "Algunas concentraciones estan en la zona de extrapolacion lejana (>150 mg/L). Estas predicciones NO son recomendadas para la toma de decisiones."
      }
      warnings <- c(warnings, list(
        div(class = "alert alert-danger mt-2", icon("ban"), msg)
      ))
    }

    if (length(warnings) > 0) tagList(warnings) else NULL
  })

  # --- Download handlers (client-side for Shinylive) ---
  observeEvent(input$download_png, {
    p <- make_plot()
    req(p)
    tmpfile <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
    ggsave(tmpfile, plot = p, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    raw_bytes <- readBin(tmpfile, "raw", file.info(tmpfile)$size)
    b64 <- jsonlite::base64_enc(raw_bytes)
    fname <- paste0("dose_response_", model_id(), "_",
                    format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"), ".png")
    session$sendCustomMessage("download_png",
                              list(content = b64, filename = fname))
  })

  observeEvent(input$download_csv, {
    results <- pred_results()
    req(results)
    csv_text <- paste(
      capture.output(write.csv(results |> select(-zone_color),
                               row.names = FALSE)),
      collapse = "\n"
    )
    fname <- paste0("predictions_", model_id(), "_",
                    format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"), ".csv")
    session$sendCustomMessage("download_csv",
                              list(content = csv_text, filename = fname))
  })

  # =========================================
  # Tab 2: EC50 Reference
  # =========================================

  output$ec50_table_title <- renderUI(tags$span(t_("ec50_title", lang())))
  output$ec50_forest_title <- renderUI(tags$span(t_("ec50_forest_title", lang())))
  output$ec50_interp_title <- renderUI(tags$span(t_("ec50_interp_title", lang())))

  output$ec50_table <- renderDT({
    ec50_display <- ec50_df |>
      mutate(
        across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 2)),
        ci = ifelse(is.na(ec50_lower), "\u2014",
                   paste0("[", ec50_lower, ", ", ec50_upper, "]"))
      ) |>
      select(Experiment = experiment, Variable = variable,
             `Time (h)` = time_h, EC50 = ec50, SE = ec50_se, `95% CI` = ci)

    datatable(ec50_display,
              options = list(pageLength = 20, dom = "t"),
              rownames = FALSE, class = "compact stripe")
  })

  output$ec50_forest <- renderPlot({
    ec50_plot <- ec50_df |>
      filter(!is.na(ec50_lower), !is.na(ec50_upper),
             ec50_upper - ec50_lower < 200) |>
      mutate(
        label = paste(experiment, variable, paste0(time_h, "h"), sep = " | "),
        time_label = paste0(time_h, "h")
      )

    if (nrow(ec50_plot) == 0) return(NULL)

    ggplot(ec50_plot, aes(x = ec50, y = reorder(label, ec50),
                          color = time_label)) +
      geom_point(size = 3) +
      geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ec50_lower, xmax = ec50_upper),
                    height = 0.3) +
      scale_color_manual(values = time_colors, name = NULL) +
      labs(x = "EC50 (mg/L)", y = NULL) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  }, res = 96)

  output$ec50_interp_body <- renderUI({
    l <- lang()
    markdown(t_("ec50_interp_text", l))
  })

  # =========================================
  # Tab 3: Study Data
  # =========================================

  output$data_photo_tab_title <- renderUI(t_("data_photo_tab", lang()))
  output$data_cyto_tab_title <- renderUI(t_("data_cyto_tab", lang()))
  output$data_photo_header <- renderUI(tags$span(t_("data_photo_title", lang())))
  output$data_cyto_header <- renderUI(tags$span(t_("data_cyto_title", lang())))

  output$data_photo_plot <- renderPlot({
    fig3_data |>
      mutate(time_label = paste0(time_h, "h")) |>
      ggplot(aes(x = concentration_mg_L, y = mean,
                color = time_label)) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se),
                   width = 2, linewidth = 0.4) +
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
      facet_grid(variable ~ experiment, scales = "free_y") +
      scale_color_manual(values = time_colors, name = NULL) +
      labs(x = "Concentration (mg/L)", y = "Response") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  }, res = 96)

  output$data_photo_table <- renderDT({
    datatable(
      fig3_data |> mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))),
      options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE),
      rownames = FALSE, class = "compact stripe"
    )
  })

  output$data_cyto_plot <- renderPlot({
    fig4_data |>
      mutate(time_label = paste0(time_h, "h")) |>
      ggplot(aes(x = concentration_mg_L, y = mean_pct,
                color = time_label)) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_pct - sd_pct / sqrt(n),
                       ymax = mean_pct + sd_pct / sqrt(n)),
                   width = 2, linewidth = 0.4) +
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
      facet_wrap(~population, scales = "free_y") +
      scale_color_manual(values = time_colors, name = NULL) +
      labs(x = "Concentration (mg/L)", y = "Population (%)") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  }, res = 96)

  output$data_cyto_table <- renderDT({
    datatable(
      fig4_data |> mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))),
      options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE),
      rownames = FALSE, class = "compact stripe"
    )
  })

  # =========================================
  # Tab 4: Methods & About
  # =========================================

  output$methods_study_header <- renderUI(
    tags$span(t_("methods_study_title", lang())))
  output$methods_stats_header <- renderUI(
    tags$span(t_("methods_stats_title", lang())))
  output$methods_citation_header <- renderUI(
    tags$span(t_("methods_citation_title", lang())))

  output$methods_study_body <- renderUI({
    markdown(t_("methods_study_text", lang()))
  })
  output$methods_stats_body <- renderUI({
    withMathJax(markdown(t_("methods_stats_text", lang())))
  })
  output$methods_citation_body <- renderUI({
    tagList(
      tags$div(
        style = "display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px;",
        tags$img(src = "logo_datalab.png", height = "80px"),
        tags$div(markdown(t_("methods_citation_text", lang())))
      )
    )
  })
}

# Translation helper
t_ <- function(key, lang) {
  val <- i18n[[lang]][[key]]
  if (is.null(val)) return(paste0("[", key, "]"))
  val
}
